name: mirasim-computer-use
description: Drive browsers, macOS apps and Electron apps through their accessibility trees: one call runs a chain of steps and reports each one.

interface.shortDescription: Drive browsers, macOS apps and Electron apps
interface.longDescription: An MCP server that drives a Chrome of its own (or your signed-in Chrome through the Mirasim extension), native macOS apps and Electron apps through their accessibility trees. One computer_repl call runs a short script of steps and reports what each one did; a click on a control another layer covers fails and names the layer.
defaultPrompt: Open the app I'm working on in the mirasim-cu browser and check that the change works.
Use the mirasim-cu browser to fill in this form and tell me what each step did.
